newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela congress won't delay CVG sale - Poletto.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela congress won't delay CVG sale - Poletto.

text.p: The slated privatization of four Venezuelan aluminum companies will go ahead in the second quarter of the year, said Alberto Poletto, president of the National Investment Fund (FIV), the government body in charge of privatization.

The schedule for the companies' sale, currently managed by parastatal Corporacion Venezolana de Guayana, has already been approved by congress and "re-opening discussions now on whether they should be sold or not would be untimely," Poletto told reporters.

His comments came as rumblings from congress are increasingly making themselves felt in the national press. But Poletto said he expected no opposition from Congress' Chamber of Deputies, although he conceded the Senate's Mining Commission might prove harder going.
"We are completely open to discuss the sale contracts," he said. The contracts are due to be aired in congress in March.
The sale of the four companies Alcasa, Venalum, Carbonorca and Bauxilum are expected to raise over $2.5 billion.
